areas.t: Incoming high pressure will decrease winds and clearing skies tonight into Friday. Temperatures will be more seasonable as well. Very good air quality this Thursday will persist into Friday, and the Green (good) AQI category is forecast statewide. Several cold frontal passages will prevent the build
